title: 0206 - the eleven numeric brackets are PROVED IN-TREE (new module TransNums): sLadderSublnDrift is now unconditional. Exact-rational exp/Taylor machinery proves the four decade-ratio log lower bounds (margins +0.86%..+1.39%) and the seven log upper bounds (margins +10.5%..+46.8%); W2SAtZeros shape statements now ALL premise-free. Board re-sweep (37 records, as_of 2026-10-28): in-tree face 0.8739461 IS the board best - no B6 fires. No RH claim
body: 0206 closes the 0205 NAMED STRETCH GOAL: the eleven numeric premises of W2SAtZeros.sLadderSublnDrift are now machine-proven in-tree, and the theorem is unconditional. (1) New module formal/RhAttack/TransNums.lean (imports Mathlib only). Machinery, all LEAN-proven: exp_eq_tsum_real (Real.exp = tsum x^n/n! via the pinned chain Real.exp_eq_exp_ℝ + NormedSpace.exp_eq_tsum + smul-to-div/field_simp); expFinsum_le_exp (finite Taylor sum <= exp, nonneg terms, Summable.sum_le_tsum - pinned arg order (s, hf), hsum implicit); fact_ge_fact_mul_pow ((N+1+k)! >= (N+1)! (N+2)^k); expTerm_le_geometric (term past N+1 is (N+2)^m times the q^m tail term, ratio a/(N+2)); finGeom_le_geom (finite geometric sum <= (1-q)^-1); expPartial_le_finsum_plus_geometric (sharp induction on tail length: S_{m+1} <= S_{N+1} + a^(N+1)/(N+1)! * sum_{j<m+1} (a/(N+2))^j - the core certificate); exp_le_finsum_plus_geometric (lift to the tsum via Real.tsum_le_of_sum_range_le; k <= N branch via the Finset.sum_subset equality-lemma + sum_congr + sum_le_sum padding trick). (2) The eleven brackets, all closed by norm_num on EXACT rationals (pins: tmp/transcnums_pins.json, verified a second time in Python): LOWER bounds log 3 > 109/100, log (10/3) > 119/100, log (31946000/10000000) > 115/100, log (100000000/31946000) > 113/100 - each as exp(b) < rational via exp_le_finsum_plus_geometric (N = 10, ratio a/12 <= 1.19/12 ~ 0.1, geometric tail); margins (rational - exp-partial-sum)/bound: +0.858%, +1.388%, +1.140%, +1.106%. UPPER bounds log T_i <= b_i (T_i < exp b_i) via expFinsum_le_exp: log 1e7 <= 17 (margin +36.24%), log 31946000 <= 18 (+15.56%), log 1e8 <= 19 (+15.51%), log 3e8 <= 20 (+27.35%), log 1e9 <= 21 (+10.48%), log 3e9 <= 22 (+12.30%), log 1e10 <= 24 (+46.75%). (3) W2SAtZeros.sLadderSublnDrift re-stated premise-free: the 11 arguments deleted; the proof binds the 11 local has from TransNums (exact type match after dsimp [T_i], T_i are integer-literal real defs). Result: the whole 0204/0205/0206 data flank is machine-checked with ZERO external numeric inputs - sLadderRising (contradicts O(1)-at-the-zeros on the measured domain), sLadderConcaveInT, and sLadderSublnDrift (SL(T_i)/log T_i strictly decreasing at all 7 steps, total drift -16.19%). (4) Same-orbit housekeeping: the board re-sweep of the post-0205 orbit (live catalogue, as_of 2026-10-28, 37 records; theta stored as {numerator, denominator} pairs - earlier raw-float scan was a misparse) confirms the in-tree face theta = 8739461/10000000 = 0.8739461 (Z78DensityRefined, PR #90, adopted 0203) IS the current board best; all 36 other records weaker; B6 does not fire. (5) Pinned-API lessons (verified online-first per the iron rule, then corrobated in .lake/packages/mathlib v4.33.1/4.34): (a) this pin's exp lives under the NormedSpace namespace (normed-space exp was moved out of the root namespace to avoid Real/Complex clashes) - use NormedSpace.exp_eq_tsum etc; (b) Finset.sum_subset is the EQUALITY lemma (h : s1 ⊆ s2, hf : zero outside) with implicit sets - not a monotonicity lemma; monotone nonneg subset sums need padding (sum_congr + sum_subset-equality + sum_le_sum pointwise); Summable.sum_le_tsum takes (s, hf) with hsum implicit; (c) Nat.factorial_pos is Nat-typed (use Nat.cast_nonneg on the real side); (d) Mathlib changelog: div_le_div_iff was DELETED and the div-le/lt iff family renamed to Unicode-subscript names (div_le_div_iff₀ : 0 < b -> 0 < d -> a/b <= c/d <-> a*d <= c*b) - the ASCII '0' variants do not exist; (e) calc step PROOFS inside induction/cases branches must be single-line (braced) - multi-line by-blocks break the calc parser with 'unexpected identifier; expected :=' cascades; (f) rw [show E from by omega] - the `from` form, not `by`; (g) scoped factorial `!` notation interacts badly in induction-branch calc - spell Nat.factorial explicitly there; (h) `simpa [Nat.add_comm]` recurses (infinite loop) - never list Nat.add_comm in simp. Builds: targeted TransNums 8706 green; W2SAtZeros 8707 green; full package build green (see build log). No RH claim: everything here is the measured/structural DATA side of the A1 clause; hA1 (data-free |S(gamma)| <= C at the zeros) remains the single named open theorem. Next named A1 actions: (i) the hA1 theorem attempt itself (A1Growth wires + W2Beyond3 telescope + this flank as context), (ii) optional higher-T census beyond 3e10 for dS/d ln t to separate slow saturation from slow divergence.
